verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes an 'API Reference' page (docs-24) implying documented API endpoints, but a direct probe for a downloadable OpenAPI/swagger spec file at the documentation site returned 404 on all candidate paths (datadog-probe-2), so no confirmed machine-readable spec download was found in evidence. Missing for 10: a verified public OpenAPI/Swagger JSON or YAML download link, explicit documentation confirming spec format/versioning, and independent confirmation that the API Reference is generated from or exposes such a spec.
